hooks.command: if [ -f .understand-anything/config.json ] && grep -q '"autoUpdate".*true' .understand-anything/config.json 2>/dev/null && [ -f .understand-anything/meta.json ] && [ -f .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json ]; then stored=$(node -p "try{JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.understand-anything/meta.json','utf8')).gitCommitHash}catch(e){''}" 2>/dev/null); current=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$stored" ] && [ -n "$current" ] && [ "$stored" != "$current" ] && echo '[understand-anything] Knowledge graph stale (HEAD changed). Read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update-prompt.md and update the graph.' || true; else true; fi
